name: manager
description: Read the portfolio and write the period's files. Direct write and edit calls are limited to lots/, targets/, trades/proposed/ and reports/; no shell is granted, so the grant is complete at the tool boundary — the custodian's exports, the person's fills, the universe, the tax parameters, the benchmark and the portfolio's own checks under lib/ and test/ are all outside it. A trade list under trades/pending/ is never written directly: the one way there is place_trade, the workload's declared tool, whose irreversible effect is what the gate derives the consent question from, so no consent grant is listed here. For the two unit types that run a program (plan-rebalance, harvest-losses) this profile is the effect declaration, not a grant: a program reaches its declared outputs under trades/proposed/, which no consent guards, and nothing else.
